filing_office: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Business Registration Division
formation_document_name: Articles of Organization for Limited Liability Company (Form LLC-1)
filing_fee_notes: Add the mandatory 1 State Archives fee. Annual reports cost 12.5 online or 15 on paper.
registered_agent_rules: Continuously maintain an agent with a business address in Hawaii: a resident individual or a domestic or foreign entity authorized to transact business in Hawaii.
expedite_options: Expedited formation review costs an additional 25; turnaround was not confirmed.
annual_report_due: Due by the last day of the calendar quarter containing the registration anniversary: March 31, June 30, September 30 or December 31. No report is due in the registration year.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Hawaii Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Unemployment Insurance Division
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a Hawaii registered agent. File annual reports starting the following year.
common_mistake: Assuming every Hawaii LLC has the same annual-report deadline.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Report fee field records the online fee; paper costs 15. Direct name-search URL, standard processing time, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
